title: Open Agents Self-Hosted Fork (rmind-agents)
summary: Fork vercel-labs/open-agents to remove dependence on @vercel/sandbox and @vercel/workflow, swap the AI SDK ToolLoopAgent for the pi-coding-agent SDK so the system can route per-turn across OpenCode Go / Codex OAuth / Anthropic, and prepare deployment to agents.rmind.us via Vercel proxy + Cloudflare Tunnel + a home rack.

stories.title: Workspace, branch, and PRD
acceptanceCriteria: Fork rmind-agents exists under j8ckfi on GitHub with upstream remote pointing at vercel-labs/open-agents
Branch rmind/self-hosted-fork is checked out locally at C:/Users/Jack/projects/rmind-agents
.omc/prd.json exists with task-specific acceptance criteria (no boilerplate)
.omc/progress.txt initialized with the recon summary

stories.title: LocalDockerSandbox base image
acceptanceCriteria: packages/sandbox/docker/Dockerfile exists and installs Node 20+, Bun, pnpm, Python 3.12, git, curl, ripgrep, fd, jq, build-essential, ca-certificates
Dockerfile creates a non-root user `agent` and sets WORKDIR to /workspace
packages/sandbox/docker/build.sh exists and tags the image as ${SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE:-open-agents-sandbox:base}
Dockerfile does not COPY any host secrets and does not bake in tokens

stories.title: LocalDockerSandbox implements Sandbox interface
acceptanceCriteria: packages/sandbox/local-docker/sandbox.ts exports class LocalDockerSandbox implementing every method declared on Sandbox in packages/sandbox/interface.ts
Implementation uses dockerode bound to the docker socket from SANDBOX_DOCKER_HOST or default
exec() honours the AbortSignal in options and returns ExecResult with success/exitCode/stdout/stderr/truncated
domain(port) returns http://<host>:<hostPort> using the dynamic port mapping established at create()
stop() removes the container; getState() returns a serializable LocalDockerSandboxState

stories.title: Sandbox factory dispatch
acceptanceCriteria: packages/sandbox/local-docker/connect.ts exports connectLocalDockerSandbox returning Sandbox
packages/sandbox/factory.ts connectSandbox dispatches on state.type === 'local-docker'
packages/sandbox/index.ts re-exports the local-docker entry points alongside the Vercel ones
packages/sandbox/types.ts SandboxState union includes a LocalDockerState variant
packages/sandbox/package.json gains dockerode and tar-stream as runtime deps

stories.title: Pi agent wrapper package
acceptanceCriteria: packages/pi-agent/package.json exists with dependency @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent ^0.70.2
packages/pi-agent/src/index.ts exports runAgentTurn() returning AgentTurnResult
Internal createAgentSession call wires AuthStorage from PI_AUTH_PATH and ModelRegistry from PI_MODELS_PATH
AgentSessionEvent stream is converted to UIMessageChunk shape (start/text/tool-call/tool-result/finish)
Errors during refresh of OAuth tokens surface as a typed AgentTurnResult.error

stories.title: Pi tool adapter from sandbox
acceptanceCriteria: packages/pi-agent/src/tools.ts exports buildSandboxTools(sandbox)
Tools cover: read, write, edit, grep, glob, bash, web_fetch — each backed by the Sandbox interface only
Schemas are TypeBox; AbortSignal is forwarded into sandbox.exec
bash tool maps onto sandbox.exec with sandbox.workingDirectory as cwd default and 5-minute timeout
web_fetch is implemented out-of-sandbox using globalThis.fetch

stories.title: Models template + auth bootstrap docs
acceptanceCriteria: packages/pi-agent/templates/models.json includes opencode-go, codex (oauth), anthropic providers

Models listed: glm-5.1, kimi-k2.6, deepseek-v4-pro, qwen-3.6-plus, minimax-m2.7 under opencode-go; claude-opus-4-7 and claude-sonnet-4-6 under anthropic; gpt-5.4-codex and gpt-5-codex-mini under codex
packages/pi-agent/templates/auth.json.example is committed (placeholders only, no real tokens)
packages/pi-agent/README.md documents `pi auth login codex` flow over SSH

stories.title: Workflow shim package
acceptanceCriteria: packages/local-workflow workspace package literally named 'workflow' shadows the npm package
Implements sleep (number|Date), getWorkflowMetadata (with workflowRunId alias), getWritable, FatalError, RetryableError, getStepMetadata
Implements getRun(runId).getReadable<T>() / cancel(), and start(workflow, args[]) returning Promise<RunHandle>
Process-local registry persists each run's chunk buffer in memory and replays from a cursor
workflow/next subpath exposes withWorkflow as an identity wrapper so apps/web's next.config.ts compiles

stories.title: Wire pi agent runner into web app
acceptanceCriteria: apps/web/app/workflows/chat.ts gates between ToolLoopAgent and pi-agent via env AGENT_BACKEND=pi|tool-loop
Pi path constructs sandbox via connectSandbox, then calls runAgentTurn with chat history converted to pi format
UIMessageChunk events from pi reach writable.getWriter().write(part) in the same shape the existing UI consumes
Cancellation via abortController propagates to the pi session and to sandbox.exec
bun run typecheck on apps/web exits 0

stories.title: Docker Compose for the rack
acceptanceCriteria: deploy/rack/docker-compose.yml exposes services: web (Next.js), postgres, cloudflared
web service mounts /var/run/docker.sock so it can spawn sandbox containers, mounts /data/pi for auth.json and models.json, and reads env from .env
postgres service has a named volume
cloudflared service uses image cloudflare/cloudflared:latest and reads token/config from env
deploy/rack/.env.example lists every required variable from spec §6

stories.title: Vercel proxy project
acceptanceCriteria: deploy/vercel/next.config.ts rewrites all dynamic routes to ${RACK_TUNNEL_ORIGIN}
deploy/vercel/vercel.json sets framework Next.js, build/install commands
deploy/vercel/app/api/github/app/callback/route.ts forwards the callback to the rack with the original query string and cookies
deploy/vercel/package.json declares Next 15 minimal deps and a vercel-build script
deploy/vercel/README.md states the manual Vercel CLI steps the user must run

stories.title: Cloudflare tunnel template
acceptanceCriteria: deploy/cloudflared/config.template.yml maps hostname agents.rmind.us → http://web:3000 with WS upgrade enabled
deploy/cloudflared/README.md documents cloudflared tunnel create + DNS route + credentials placement
Heartbeat / 100s idle timeout mitigation is documented

stories.title: Deployment runbook + .env.example
acceptanceCriteria: DEPLOYMENT.md walks through every prerequisite the user must satisfy: Docker, GitHub App, Vercel auth + project, Cloudflare tunnel, DNS, API keys, pi auth login over SSH
DEPLOYMENT.md states explicitly which steps the agent automated and which require user action
.env.example committed at repo root mirroring deploy/rack/.env.example
DEPLOYMENT.md includes a smoke-test checklist (login, create task, see PR)

bun run typecheck on packages/sandbox, packages/local-workflow, packages/pi-agent, and apps/web exits 0
Each phase committed as a discrete commit on rmind/self-hosted-fork (3 commits: sandbox, pi-agent+workflow+deploy, type-fixes)
